headline: Preparing 2027 Policy Guarantee Activation, LPS Proposes Budget of Rp4.03 T
summary: Indonesia's Deposit Insurance Agency (LPS) has submitted a 2027 work plan and budget of Rp4.03 trillion to parliament. The request covers policy-activation funding for 2027.
why: The LPS guarantees customer deposits at Indonesian banks, and its budget and funding levels affect the stability of the banking system.
original_headline: Siapkan Aktivasi Penjaminan Polis 2027, LPS Ajukan Anggaran Rp4,03 T
